description: Tensors and Dynamic neural networks in Python with strong GPU acceleration
vibe: Guardrails first: no autonomous GitHub actions, no silent asserts, no unnecessary rebuilds.
highlights: AI agents are explicitly forbidden from acting autonomously on GitHub; all AI-generated content must be labeled and human-reviewed.
Ruff S101 must never be silenced with noqa; asserts must be rewritten as explicit raises to survive python -O.
The .ci/docker directory is content-hashed, so any edit triggers a full Docker rebuild and must be avoided unless intended.
Builds must use exactly `pip install -e . -v --no-build-isolation`; no alternative build commands are allowed.
Commit messages must include a Test Plan with literal commands, root-cause explanations for bug fixes, and AI-assistance disclosure.
assessment: This file treats agent behavior as a security and correctness surface, not just a style guide. The anti-autonomy GitHub policy, the S101 rewrite rule, and the Docker hash warning all prevent classes of silent, expensive, or irreversible mistakes. The result is a rare example of agent instructions that encode hard-won operational knowledge rather than generic advice.
